title: تعریف کاتالوگ مدل دستگاه و انتخاب مدل هنگام ثبت دستگاه
description: مدل دستگاه به یک کاتالوگ قابل مدیریت توسط مدیر مجاز تبدیل شود و در فرم ایجاد و ویرایش دستگاه از مدل‌های تعریف‌شده انتخاب شود. مطابق تصویر مرجع، هر مدل شامل نوع دستگاه، نسخه، کد یکتای مدل و نام نمایشی باشد. پنج نوع دستگاه: یونیت، کامان‌ریل، ترکیبی یونیت و کامان‌ریل، تست پمپ، تست کامل. سه نسخه برای هر نوع: باکس کنار دستگاه، کامپیوتری، اقتصادی؛ در مجموع ۱۵ ترکیب اولیه. کدهای پیشنهادی تصویر: یونیت AD-UNIT-B / AD-UNIT-PC / AD-UNIT-E؛ کامان‌ریل AD-CR-B / AD-CR-PC / AD-CR-E؛ ترکیبی AD-COMBO-B / AD-COMBO-PC / AD-COMBO-E؛ تست پمپ AD-PUMP-B / AD-PUMP-PC / AD-PUMP-E؛ تست کامل AD-PRO-B / AD-PRO-PC / AD-PRO-E. تصویر کارت‌های تصویری برای انتخاب آسان نوع و نسخه را پیشنهاد می‌کند؛ انتخاب در فرم دستگاه به شکل روشن و RTL و مناسب موبایل ارائه شود. فرم تعریف مدل حداقل نوع، نسخه، کد یکتا و نام نمایشی داشته باشد؛ نمایش نوع و نسخه و کد مطابق تصویر باشد. هر مشتری بتواند چند دستگاه مستقل با سریال یکتای خود داشته باشد؛ رابطه چنددستگاهی محدود یا به رابطه یک‌به‌یک تبدیل نشود. داده‌های موجود با مهاجرت سازگار حفظ شوند؛ رشته‌های مدل قبلی بدون نگاشت معتبر از بین نروند. اثر تغییر کاتالوگ بر فیلترها، جزئیات دستگاه، API و سازگاری و هدف‌گذاری نسخه‌های نرم‌افزار بررسی و مدیریت شود.
acceptance_criteria: مدیر مجاز مدل تعریف کند و کارکنان مجاز هنگام ثبت دستگاه مدل را از کاتالوگ انتخاب کنند؛ ۱۵ ترکیب و کدهای تصویر بدون تکرار پشتیبانی شوند؛ نوع و نسخه و کد معتبر و نام نمایشی روشن باشند؛ انتخاب موبایل و RTL و کیبورد قابل استفاده باشد؛ یک مشتری حداقل دو دستگاه با مدل‌های متفاوت داشته باشد؛ سریال دستگاه همچنان یکتا بماند؛ داده‌ها و تطبیق نسخه‌های نرم‌افزار در مهاجرت حفظ شوند؛ دسترسی مدیریتی و جداسازی سازمان‌ها سمت سرور و با تست API و مرورگر تأیید شوند.
close_reason: Implemented audited staff catalog with immutable model identity, 15 seeded reference combinations, active-only new assignment and protected device FK. Added Persian RTL model administration and device selection, preserved unmatched legacy compatibility keys and multiple devices per customer. PostgreSQL suite: 300 passed including migration, role, release, inventory and tenant tests. New browser scenarios: 2 passed; existing shell/customer scenarios also passed. Full production Docker build succeeded using configurable official Node ECR source after Docker Hub 403. Local migrations 0007/0008 applied, API restarted, readiness and dashboard return 200, unauthenticated catalog returns 403, all 15 seed models verified. Remote deployment still requires migrations before traffic.

title: افزودن نمایش موارد بایگانی‌شده در فهرست‌ها
description: در تمام فهرست‌های مدیریتی که موجودیت آن‌ها قابلیت بایگانی دارد، فیلتر واضح فعال / بایگانی‌شده / همه اضافه شود؛ از جمله دستگاه‌ها و سازمان‌های مشتری. جست‌وجو، فیلترهای دیگر، شمارش و صفحه‌بندی باید با وضعیت انتخابی سازگار باشند و سمت سرور اعمال شوند. برای موجودیت‌های فاقد بایگانی، رفتار متناسب با مدل مانند غیرفعال یا پس‌گرفته‌شده بررسی و با برچسب دقیق ارائه شود؛ حذف، بایگانی و غیرفعال‌سازی یکسان فرض نشوند. محدودیت نقش‌ها و جداسازی سازمان‌ها حفظ شود؛ پنل مشتری همچنان فقط دستگاه‌های فعلی و مجاز سازمان را ببیند و دسترسی تازه به دستگاه بایگانی‌شده یا منتقل‌شده پیدا نکند. این تسک شامل افزودن عملیات بازیابی یا تغییر چرخه عمر موجودیت‌ها نیست.
acceptance_criteria: فهرست‌های دارای قابلیت بایگانی فیلتر فعال / بایگانی‌شده / همه داشته باشند؛ وضعیت انتخابی در جست‌وجو، شمارش و صفحه‌بندی دقیق اعمال شود؛ حالت خالی و بارگذاری و خطا واضح باشند؛ رفتار موبایل و RTL و دسترسی‌پذیری تأیید شود؛ تست API و مرورگر برای فیلترها، مجوزها و عدم افشای موارد غیرمجاز وجود داشته باشد.

title: CUST-004: Expose read-only tenant-scoped customer device APIs
description:
Plan reference: CUST-004; docs/implementation-plan.md section 6, approved customer-access increment.

## Scope
Add GET /api/v1/customer/devices/, /devices/{id}/ and /summary/ in the customer namespace. Resolve organization exclusively from the authenticated user's current membership. Scope querysets before lookups, search, filtering, pagination and aggregates; deny other methods. Allowlist only id, serial_number, model_name, software_version, location, last_seen_at and estimated online status; summary exposes only that organization's device/online/offline counts, generated_at and online_window_minutes. Exclude archived devices. Return a consistent 404 for absent or foreign device IDs and reject unsupported scope/filter parameters. Do not reuse unrestricted staff serializers or expose credentials, site contact details, internal notes, raw payloads, events/fault history, release/assignment metadata or audit records. Apply current organization ownership on every request and prevent cross-tenant caching.

title: CUST-001: Add customer account membership and additive migrations
description:
Plan reference: CUST-001; docs/implementation-plan.md section 6, approved customer-access increment.

## Scope
Retain Django's existing user model and staff flags/groups. Add CustomerMembership with a unique user relation and protected Customer foreign key: one organization per customer account, many accounts per organization. Use membership as the customer-role marker; customer users have neither staff nor superuser flags nor staff groups. Centralize eligibility checks and reject mixed identities. Do not infer membership from contact email, username, or device serial. Review existing database data before applying additive migrations; do not reset databases, replace AUTH_USER_MODEL, or alter historical migrations. Archiving an organization denies portal access but does not revoke device credentials or interrupt devices.

title: DEVICE-002: Make event batch ingestion and fault projection robust (L)
description:
Plan reference: DEVICE-002; docs/implementation-plan.md

- **Outcome / refs:** Durable retry-compatible immutable ingestion; product §§7.4, 8.4–8.5; technical §5.3.
- **Depends on:** ENG-002, ENG-003, DEVICE-001.
- **Existing paths:** `backend/devices/models.py` (`DeviceEvent`, `DeviceFault`), `serializers.py` (`EventIngestSerializer`), `views.py` (`ingest_events`, `event_matches_payload`).
- **Proposed paths:** Domain service for atomic/idempotent event processing; OpenAPI/event examples.
- **Work:** Enforce max batch/body/metadata limits, timestamps, identifiers and enum constraints; define per-event accepted/duplicate/rejected result semantics; ensure conflicting ID reuse cannot mutate facts; handle race inserts; update latest fault by occurred_at with deterministic equal-time tie-break; retain receipt time; separate device last-seen semantics; choose partial-batch transaction behavior and document it. Check acknowledgement rules against device queue.
- **Acceptance:** Repeated identical event is duplicate with same ID; conflicting payload is rejected and original remains unchanged; late older fault remains in history without replacing newer fault; each accepted event has server receipt timestamp; batch outcomes are per-event and retry-safe; untrusted serial alone cannot authenticate.
- **Verification:** PostgreSQL transaction/concurrency tests and contract examples, including out-of-order and invalid mixed batches.
- **Risks/questions:** Contract compatibility with deployed devices is open. Partial batch acceptance should remain if the client reliably handles per-event results; otherwise revise with protocol owner.

Imported as open; existing implementation must be verified before closure.
close_reason: Extracted a per-event transaction service with device/credential revalidation, immutable deduplication and conflict audits, deterministic fault projection, and atomic monotonic communication freshness. Enforced bounded UTF-8 JSON envelopes, count/body/metadata byte and nesting limits, explicit timezone and configurable future skew, strict fields/types, PostgreSQL-safe metadata, and secret-free invalid-ID diagnostics. Migration 0004 preserves historical receipt values and stores the shared server batch receipt time explicitly. Final PostgreSQL suite: 143 passed, covering mixed outcomes, retry after later storage failure, concurrent duplicates/conflicts, equal-time UUID ties, revocation races, malformed Unicode and migration preservation. Ruff, uv lock, image build, Django checks and migration drift check passed. Device-owner queue/client compatibility review remains a production rollout prerequisite; documented docs/device-api.md.

- **Work:** Verify digest comparison, revoke and rotate semantics, one-time secret output, audit, invalid/archived device handling, rate limits and strict check-in schema. Define response/auth contract with device owner; check-in updates last-seen from server receive time only. Document TLS requirement and credential handling.
- **Acceptance:** Valid credential checks in only its device; revoked credential fails; replacement token works and old token fails; last_seen updates server-side; malformed/oversized input rejected; secret is never retrievable from DB/log.
- **Verification:** Authentication/check-in API tests, credential rotation manual CLI check.
- **Risks/questions:** Device-side client is absent, so backward compatibility and rollout sequencing require device owner sign-off.

Imported as open; existing implementation must be verified before closure.
close_reason: Hardened device credential and check-in contract: atomic audited provisioning/rotation/revocation services plus revocation API and CLI; no-store one-time secret responses; archived/malformed credential rejection; locked credential revalidation before check-in writes; bounded UTF-8 JSON parser with strict schema and heartbeat preservation; explicit per-device endpoint throttles; check-in respects production rollout gate. Documented docs/device-api.md and env settings. Final PostgreSQL suite: 93 passed; Ruff, uv lock, Django configuration, migration drift/status, production image build and CLI help passed. Device-client source is absent: owner compatibility review and production shared-cache/edge limits remain rollout prerequisites.

title: AUTH-001: Define and implement staff browser session lifecycle (L)
description:
Plan reference: AUTH-001; docs/implementation-plan.md

Audit sign-in/out outcomes without secrets.

Imported as open; existing implementation must be verified before closure.
notes: Backend implemented and verified: PostgreSQL row-locked fixed-window login limits shared across workers and authenticated/anonymous requests; NUM_PROXIES defaults to zero to reject spoofed forwarding identities; keyed client-address digests; secret-free failed/throttled login audits; successful login audit and session establishment in one transaction; CSRF, session rotation, expiry, logout, inactive/password-change rejection verified. Added migration 0003 and seven-day counter pruning command. Focused auth suite passed; integrated PostgreSQL suite: 57 passed; Ruff, uv lock, Docker build, Django checks and migration drift check passed. Keep task in progress pending interactive browser login/refresh/logout/expiry/keyboard acceptance and final provider-specific HTTPS origin/proxy configuration.
close_reason: Completed real Microsoft Edge browser acceptance against an isolated migrated PostgreSQL database and temporary accounts. Nine browser checks passed: keyboard login, HttpOnly SameSite cookie and no stored bearer token, refresh restoration, user-dialog Escape/focus, admin-provisioned support login and role denial, server logout revocation, actual server-session expiry, mobile RTL login/dashboard, no uncaught browser exceptions. QA database and services removed afterward. Backend security suite previously passed as part of 143 PostgreSQL tests. Provider HTTPS origin/proxy and perimeter configuration remain production deployment prerequisites.

- **Existing paths:** `backend/devices/views.py`, `serializers.py`, `authentication.py`, `permissions.py`, `models.py`.
- **Proposed paths:** `backend/tests/` or per-app `tests/` modules, pytest configuration in `backend/pyproject.toml`.
- **Work:** Configure pytest against PostgreSQL; add behavior tests first for device credential auth/revocation, unique serial/event constraints, duplicate/conflicting event IDs, out-of-order fault state, update target/version eligibility, and access-role boundaries. Prefer API contract tests over implementation-mock tests.
- **Acceptance:** Tests fail against the relevant broken behavior, pass against current intended behavior, and run from one documented command using PostgreSQL.
- **Verification:** Pytest locally/CI after OPS-002 establishes CI.
- **Risks/questions:** Existing code may expose latent mismatches. Fix product behavior in subsequent domain tasks, not by weakening assertions.

close_reason: Configured locked PostgreSQL Pytest harness and documented one-command execution. Added explicit archived/global serial and per-device event identity contracts plus migration regression.
